name: uams-web/uams-plugin-template
description: The starting point for a UAMS-Web WordPress plugin.

scripts-descriptions.setup:integration: Install the Integration suite's own Composer setup (PHPUnit 9.6, wp-phpunit, the polyfills).
scripts-descriptions.lint:floor: Parse every shipped PHP file with the PHP named in LINT_PHP (default: php), the supported floor.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run both suites, each in its own process, so the Unit suite never sees WordPress.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the PHPUnit 9.6 suite that boots WordPress through wp-phpunit against the test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:refactor: Show what Rector would change; fails when it would change anything.
scripts-descriptions.build: Build the upload ZIP from the download keep-list into build/.
scripts-descriptions.check:archive: Check that a branch download holds only what the plugin runs.
